<a id="deepnavy-v1-adminerrordetail"></a>
### Message `deepnavy.v1.AdminErrorDetail`

AdminErrorDetail is attached to non-OK Connect/gRPC statuses. safe_message
 may be displayed to an administrator, but must never include secrets,
 provider payloads or identifiers, SQL, Kubernetes credentials, or customer
 data outside the administrator's authorized scope.

| Field | Number | Type | Cardinality | Description |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| `reason` | 1 | [`deepnavy.v1.AdminErrorReason`](#deepnavy-v1-adminerrorreason) | singular | — |
| `safe_message` | 2 | `string` | singular | — |

<a id="deepnavy-v1-adminprojectionstatus"></a>
### Message `deepnavy.v1.AdminProjectionStatus`

| Field | Number | Type | Cardinality | Description |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| `availability` | 1 | [`deepnavy.v1.AdminProjectionAvailability`](#deepnavy-v1-adminprojectionavailability) | singular | — |
| `unavailable_fields` | 2 | `string` | repeated | Exact snake_case protobuf field names in the containing message. This list<br> is empty for COMPLETE and must not name identity, period, or generated_at. |
| `source_observed_at` | 3 | `google.protobuf.Timestamp` | singular | source_observed_at is the oldest observation contributing to the current<br> projection and lets clients communicate freshness without provider data. |

<a id="deepnavy-v1-adminoverview"></a>
### Message `deepnavy.v1.AdminOverview`

AdminOverview is the top-level founder snapshot. All Money values use one
 ISO-4217 reporting currency; a server must reject mixed-currency aggregation
 unless it applies and audits an explicit conversion policy. Point-in-time
 counts and recurring revenue are measured at reporting_period.ended_at;
 event counts cover the period.

| Field | Number | Type | Cardinality | Description |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| `monthly_recurring_revenue` | 1 | [`deepnavy.v1.Money`](#deepnavy-v1-money) | singular | — |
| `annual_recurring_revenue` | 2 | [`deepnavy.v1.Money`](#deepnavy-v1-money) | singular | — |
| `active_customers` | 3 | `int64` | singular | — |
| `active_teams` | 4 | `int64` | singular | — |
| `gross_margin` | 5 | `double` | singular | gross_margin is a ratio, where 1.0 means 100%. It is zero when the ratio<br> is unavailable; new clients should use gross_margin_ratio for presence. |
| `production_incidents` | 6 | `int64` | singular | — |
| `pull_requests_merged` | 7 | `int64` | singular | — |
| `reporting_period` | 8 | [`deepnavy.v1.ReportingPeriod`](#deepnavy-v1-reportingperiod) | singular | — |
| `generated_at` | 9 | `google.protobuf.Timestamp` | singular | — |
| `new_customers` | 10 | `int64` | singular | — |
| `churned_customers` | 11 | `int64` | singular | — |
| `net_revenue_retention_ratio` | 12 | `double` | optional | Ratios use 1.0 for 100% and may exceed 1.0. Absence means the denominator<br> was zero or the measurement was not trustworthy for this period. |
| `currently_active_agents` | 13 | `int64` | singular | — |
| `open_alerts` | 14 | `int64` | singular | — |
| `at_risk_customers` | 15 | `int64` | singular | — |
| `gross_margin_ratio` | 16 | `double` | optional | Ratios use 1.0 for 100% and may be negative. Absence means revenue was zero<br> or the measurement was not trustworthy for this period. |
| `customer_churn_ratio` | 17 | `double` | optional | customer_churn_ratio is in [0.0, 1.0]. Absence means there was no starting<br> customer cohort or the measurement was not trustworthy for this period. |
| `projection_status` | 18 | [`deepnavy.v1.AdminProjectionStatus`](#deepnavy-v1-adminprojectionstatus) | singular | — |

<a id="deepnavy-v1-adminauditevent"></a>
### Message `deepnavy.v1.AdminAuditEvent`

AdminAuditEvent is one immutable administrative audit record. It exposes deep
 navy identifiers and a stable human actor label; it never exposes provider
 object identifiers or credentials. source_ip and user_agent are operator
 forensic metadata and may be empty.

| Field | Number | Type | Cardinality | Description |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | 1 | `string` | singular | — |
| `occurred_at` | 2 | `google.protobuf.Timestamp` | singular | — |
| `actor_user_id` | 3 | `string` | singular | actor_user_id is the deep navy user UUID; empty when the actor is no longer<br> resolvable. actor_label is a human label (email or GitHub login) and may be<br> empty. |
| `actor_label` | 4 | `string` | singular | — |
| `action` | 5 | `string` | singular | action is the audited operation, for example "admin.rpc.read" or a future<br> "admin.team.suspend". resource_type and resource_id identify the target. |
| `resource_type` | 6 | `string` | singular | — |
| `resource_id` | 7 | `string` | singular | — |
| `organization_id` | 8 | `string` | singular | organization_id is the deep navy organization the action targeted, when<br> applicable. |
| `request_id` | 9 | `string` | singular | — |
| `source_ip` | 10 | `string` | singular | — |
| `user_agent` | 11 | `string` | singular | — |

<a id="deepnavy-v1-adminerrorreason"></a>
### Enum `deepnavy.v1.AdminErrorReason`

| Value | Number | Description |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `ADMIN_ERROR_REASON_UNSPECIFIED` | 0 | — |
| `ADMIN_ERROR_REASON_NOT_AUTHORIZED` | 1 | The verified principal is not a founder or admin, has no MFA-backed admin<br> session, or otherwise lacks access. Returned with PERMISSION_DENIED. |
| `ADMIN_ERROR_REASON_INVALID_REPORTING_PERIOD` | 2 | The reporting period is invalid or exceeds a server-defined limit.<br> Returned with INVALID_ARGUMENT. |
| `ADMIN_ERROR_REASON_INVALID_FILTER` | 3 | One or more filters cannot be combined. Returned with INVALID_ARGUMENT. |
| `ADMIN_ERROR_REASON_CURSOR_EXPIRED` | 4 | A page token or stream sequence is no longer retained. Returned with<br> OUT_OF_RANGE so the caller can restart from a fresh list response. |
| `ADMIN_ERROR_REASON_DATA_UNAVAILABLE` | 5 | A required source has not produced a trustworthy current snapshot.<br> Returned with UNAVAILABLE rather than fabricating a zero value. |
| `ADMIN_ERROR_REASON_UNAUTHENTICATED` | 6 | The request has no valid/active authentication. Returned with<br> UNAUTHENTICATED; this is distinct from an authenticated principal that<br> lacks an admin role or MFA-backed admin session. |
| `ADMIN_ERROR_REASON_INVALID_PAGE_REQUEST` | 7 | page_size is negative or above the admin maximum, or page_token is invalid<br> for this caller/filter/snapshot. Returned with INVALID_ARGUMENT. |
| `ADMIN_ERROR_REASON_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` | 8 | The requested deep navy resource does not exist. Returned with NOT_FOUND. |

<a id="deepnavy-v1-adminprojectionavailability"></a>
### Enum `deepnavy.v1.AdminProjectionAvailability`

AdminProjectionAvailability prevents unsupported or stale founder metrics
 from being represented as trustworthy protobuf scalar zero values.

| Value | Number | Description |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `ADMIN_PROJECTION_AVAILABILITY_UNSPECIFIED` | 0 | — |
| `ADMIN_PROJECTION_AVAILABILITY_COMPLETE` | 1 | Every field in the containing projection is backed by a current,<br> authoritative source. |
| `ADMIN_PROJECTION_AVAILABILITY_PARTIAL` | 2 | Authoritative fields are present, while unavailable_fields identifies the<br> exact protobuf field names that callers must hide rather than read as zero. |
| `ADMIN_PROJECTION_AVAILABILITY_UNAVAILABLE` | 3 | No trustworthy projection exists. RPCs should normally return<br> ADMIN_ERROR_REASON_DATA_UNAVAILABLE instead of a message in this state. |
| `ADMIN_PROJECTION_AVAILABILITY_STALE` | 4 | A projection exists but is older than its declared freshness objective. |

<a id="deepnavy-v1-adminservice"></a>
### Service `deepnavy.v1.AdminService`

AdminService is a read-only projection over the same versioned API used by
 customer clients. Every RPC requires server-side founder/admin authorization,
 an MFA-backed short-lived session, and an audit record. Request fields never
 substitute for authorization.

| RPC | Request | Response | Streaming | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GetAdminOverview` | [`deepnavy.v1.GetAdminOverviewRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-getadminoverviewrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.GetAdminOverviewResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-getadminoverviewresponse) | unary | GetAdminOverview is retained at its original stable procedure path and is<br> additive-compatible with the first generated clients. |
| `ListAdminCustomers` | [`deepnavy.v1.ListAdminCustomersRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-listadmincustomersrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.ListAdminCustomersResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-listadmincustomersresponse) | unary | — |
| `GetAdminCustomer` | [`deepnavy.v1.GetAdminCustomerRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-getadmincustomerrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.GetAdminCustomerResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-getadmincustomerresponse) | unary | — |
| `ListAdminCustomerReliabilityRecords` | [`deepnavy.v1.ListAdminCustomerReliabilityRecordsRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-listadmincustomerreliabilityrecordsrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.ListAdminCustomerReliabilityRecordsResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-listadmincustomerreliabilityrecordsresponse) | unary | — |
| `GetAdminEconomics` | [`deepnavy.v1.GetAdminEconomicsRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-getadmineconomicsrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.GetAdminEconomicsResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-getadmineconomicsresponse) | unary | — |
| `ListAdminEconomicsSlices` | [`deepnavy.v1.ListAdminEconomicsSlicesRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-listadmineconomicsslicesrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.ListAdminEconomicsSlicesResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-listadmineconomicsslicesresponse) | unary | — |
| `GetAdminFleet` | [`deepnavy.v1.GetAdminFleetRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-getadminfleetrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.GetAdminFleetResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-getadminfleetresponse) | unary | — |
| `ListAdminRuntimeInstances` | [`deepnavy.v1.ListAdminRuntimeInstancesRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-listadminruntimeinstancesrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.ListAdminRuntimeInstancesResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-listadminruntimeinstancesresponse) | unary | — |
| `StreamAdminRuntimeInstances` | [`deepnavy.v1.StreamAdminRuntimeInstancesRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-streamadminruntimeinstancesrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.StreamAdminRuntimeInstancesResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-streamadminruntimeinstancesresponse) | server | — |
| `GetAdminBilling` | [`deepnavy.v1.GetAdminBillingRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-getadminbillingrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.GetAdminBillingResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-getadminbillingresponse) | unary | — |
| `ListAdminBillingAccounts` | [`deepnavy.v1.ListAdminBillingAccountsRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-listadminbillingaccountsrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.ListAdminBillingAccountsResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-listadminbillingaccountsresponse) | unary | — |
| `ListAdminBillingReconciliationIssues` | [`deepnavy.v1.ListAdminBillingReconciliationIssuesRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-listadminbillingreconciliationissuesrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.ListAdminBillingReconciliationIssuesResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-listadminbillingreconciliationissuesresponse) | unary | — |
| `ListAdminAlerts` | [`deepnavy.v1.ListAdminAlertsRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-listadminalertsrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.ListAdminAlertsResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-listadminalertsresponse) | unary | — |
| `StreamAdminAlerts` | [`deepnavy.v1.StreamAdminAlertsRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-streamadminalertsrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.StreamAdminAlertsResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-streamadminalertsresponse) | server | — |
| `ListAdminAuditEvents` | [`deepnavy.v1.ListAdminAuditEventsRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-listadminauditeventsrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.ListAdminAuditEventsResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-listadminauditeventsresponse) | unary | ListAdminAuditEvents returns the immutable administrative audit trail<br> (admin RPC access and, in future, privileged mutations). |

A short-lived credential. |

<a id="deepnavy-v1-refreshsessionrequest"></a>
### Message `deepnavy.v1.RefreshSessionRequest`

RefreshSession carries no fields. The credential that authorizes it is a
 browser cookie the server set and only the server can read, so there is
 nothing for the caller to supply and nothing it could forge by supplying it.

This message has no fields.

| Field | Number | Type | Cardinality | Description |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| `session_token` | 1 | `string` | singular | Same contract as CompleteGitHubSignInResponse.session_token: a credential<br> that lives in browser memory and nowhere else. |
| `expires_at` | 2 | `google.protobuf.Timestamp` | singular | — |
| `user` | 3 | [`deepnavy.v1.CurrentUser`](#deepnavy-v1-currentuser) | singular | — |
| `memberships` | 4 | [`deepnavy.v1.OrganizationMembership`](#deepnavy-v1-organizationmembership) | repeated | — |

This message has no fields.

<a id="deepnavy-v1-signoutresponse"></a>
### Message `deepnavy.v1.SignOutResponse`

This message has no fields.

<a id="deepnavy-v1-authservice"></a>
### Service `deepnavy.v1.AuthService`

| RPC | Request | Response | Streaming | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GetCurrentUser` | [`deepnavy.v1.GetCurrentUserRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-getcurrentuserrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.GetCurrentUserResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-getcurrentuserresponse) | unary | GetCurrentUser resolves (and, on first sign-in, synchronizes) the user from<br> verified Cognito claims. It never accepts a principal or organization ID<br> and never creates an organization implicitly. |
| `StartGitHubSignIn` | [`deepnavy.v1.StartGitHubSignInRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-startgithubsigninrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.StartGitHubSignInResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-startgithubsigninresponse) | unary | — |
| `CompleteGitHubSignIn` | [`deepnavy.v1.CompleteGitHubSignInRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-completegithubsigninrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.CompleteGitHubSignInResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-completegithubsigninresponse) | unary | CompleteGitHubSignIn exchanges the one-time GitHub authorization code for a<br> deep navy customer session, capturing the GitHub identity and the App<br> installation selected during sign-in. It is public (no bearer required). |
| `RefreshSession` | [`deepnavy.v1.RefreshSessionRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-refreshsessionrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.RefreshSessionResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-refreshsessionresponse) | unary | RefreshSession mints a new bearer token from the httpOnly refresh cookie<br> CompleteGitHubSignIn set, so a reload does not cost the customer a round<br> trip through GitHub.<br><br> The session token deliberately lives in browser memory and is gone the<br> moment the page unloads. That protects it from theft by injected script,<br> but on its own it also threw away the whole eight-hour session on every<br> reload and made customers sign in again and again. The refresh cookie<br> restores continuity without weakening that: it is httpOnly, so script<br> cannot read it either, and it is the only credential this call accepts.<br><br> It is public (no bearer required) - the cookie IS the authorization. |
| `SignOut` | [`deepnavy.v1.SignOutRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-signoutrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.SignOutResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-signoutresponse) | unary | — |

<a id="deepnavy-v1-invoice"></a>
### Message `deepnavy.v1.Invoice`

Invoice is a provider-independent, organization-scoped projection populated
 only after deep navy verifies a signed provider webhook and retrieves the
 authoritative invoice server-side. Provider customer, subscription, event,
 and invoice identifiers are never exposed through this message.

| Field | Number | Type | Cardinality | Description |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | 1 | `string` | singular | id is deep navy's stable public invoice identifier. |
| `organization_id` | 2 | `string` | singular | — |
| `subscription_id` | 3 | `string` | singular | subscription_id is deep navy's local subscription identifier. |
| `status` | 4 | [`deepnavy.v1.InvoiceStatus`](#deepnavy-v1-invoicestatus) | singular | — |

| `amount_due` | 7 | [`deepnavy.v1.Money`](#deepnavy-v1-money) | singular | — |
| `amount_paid` | 8 | [`deepnavy.v1.Money`](#deepnavy-v1-money) | singular | — |
| `period_starts_at` | 9 | `google.protobuf.Timestamp` | singular | — |
| `period_ends_at` | 10 | `google.protobuf.Timestamp` | singular | — |
| `due_at` | 11 | `google.protobuf.Timestamp` | singular | — |
| `paid_at` | 12 | `google.protobuf.Timestamp` | singular | — |

<a id="deepnavy-v1-billingerrorreason"></a>
### Enum `deepnavy.v1.BillingErrorReason`

| Value | Number | Description |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `BILLING_ERROR_REASON_UNSPECIFIED` | 0 | — |
| `BILLING_ERROR_REASON_PLAN_NOT_AVAILABLE` | 1 | Returned with NOT_FOUND for unknown, archived, or caller-inaccessible plans<br> without disclosing provider price identifiers. |
| `BILLING_ERROR_REASON_SUBSCRIPTION_ALREADY_EXISTS` | 2 | Checkout cannot begin because the organization already has a subscription<br> that must be managed through the portal. Returned with FAILED_PRECONDITION. |
| `BILLING_ERROR_REASON_PORTAL_NOT_AVAILABLE` | 3 | The organization has no Stripe customer or manageable subscription.<br> Returned with FAILED_PRECONDITION. |
| `BILLING_ERROR_REASON_REDIRECT_NOT_ALLOWED` | 4 | A success, cancel, or return URL did not match the server-side allowlist.<br> Returned with INVALID_ARGUMENT. |
| `BILLING_ERROR_REASON_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED` | 5 | Returned with INVALID_ARGUMENT. |
| `BILLING_ERROR_REASON_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED` | 6 | The key was previously used with a different normalized request. Returned<br> with FAILED_PRECONDITION. |
| `BILLING_ERROR_REASON_NOT_AUTHORIZED` | 7 | Returned with PERMISSION_DENIED. The server must not reveal whether an<br> inaccessible organization or subscription exists globally. |
| `BILLING_ERROR_REASON_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE` | 8 | Stripe could not be reached or returned a retryable provider error.<br> Returned with UNAVAILABLE. |
| `BILLING_ERROR_REASON_CREDIT_PACK_NOT_AVAILABLE` | 9 | The requested server-owned prepaid credit pack is unavailable. Returned<br> with NOT_FOUND without exposing a Stripe Product or Price identifier. |
| `BILLING_ERROR_REASON_TEAM_NOT_AUTHORIZED` | 10 | The team is not accessible in the requested organization. Returned with<br> PERMISSION_DENIED without revealing whether it exists globally. |
| `BILLING_ERROR_REASON_ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED` | 11 | Prepaid credits require an active subscription for the organization.<br> Returned with FAILED_PRECONDITION. |
| `BILLING_ERROR_REASON_CREDIT_PACK_QUANTITY_INVALID` | 12 | The pack quantity is outside the server-owned catalog limits. Returned<br> with INVALID_ARGUMENT. |
| `BILLING_ERROR_REASON_BUDGET_CONTROL_UNAVAILABLE` | 13 | The current billing period has no enforceable team budget control.<br> Returned with UNAVAILABLE so execution fails closed. |
| `BILLING_ERROR_REASON_CREDIT_LIMIT_INVALID` | 14 | The requested hard limit is zero, negative, above prepaid availability,<br> or below usage already committed in the current billing period. |
| `BILLING_ERROR_REASON_CREDIT_CONTROL_CONFLICT` | 15 | The optimistic version no longer matches the current control row. |
| `BILLING_ERROR_REASON_INVOICE_NOT_AVAILABLE` | 16 | The invoice is unknown or inaccessible to the authenticated principal.<br> Returned with NOT_FOUND without revealing whether it exists globally. |
| `BILLING_ERROR_REASON_INVOICE_PAGE_INVALID` | 17 | The invoice page request or opaque page token is invalid. Returned with<br> INVALID_ARGUMENT without echoing token contents. |
| `BILLING_ERROR_REASON_INVOICE_HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE` | 18 | The signed-webhook-backed local invoice projection cannot be read.<br> Returned with UNAVAILABLE; clients must not fall back to browser Stripe<br> reads or infer invoice state from Checkout completion. |

<a id="deepnavy-v1-reportingperiod"></a>
### Message `deepnavy.v1.ReportingPeriod`

ReportingPeriod is a half-open UTC interval: started_at is inclusive and
 ended_at is exclusive. An empty request period selects the procedure's
 documented default; responses always return the actual applied period.

| Field | Number | Type | Cardinality | Description |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| `started_at` | 1 | `google.protobuf.Timestamp` | singular | — |
| `ended_at` | 2 | `google.protobuf.Timestamp` | singular | — |

<a id="deepnavy-v1-money"></a>
### Message `deepnavy.v1.Money`

Money is a signed ISO-4217 currency amount. currency_code is the uppercase
 three-letter code. The amount is units + nanos / 1,000,000,000; nanos must be
 in [-999,999,999, 999,999,999] and have the same sign as units when units is
 non-zero. Services must reject mixed-currency arithmetic rather than silently
 converting or dropping a currency.

| Field | Number | Type | Cardinality | Description |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| `currency_code` | 1 | `string` | singular | — |
| `units` | 2 | `int64` | singular | — |
| `nanos` | 3 | `int32` | singular | — |

<a id="deepnavy-v1-teamconversationmessage"></a>
### Message `deepnavy.v1.TeamConversationMessage`

TeamConversationMessage is one customer-safe row of a team's conversation
 with its Product Manager. It never contains a prompt transcript, reasoning,
 tool input, credential, or raw runtime identifier.

| Field | Number | Type | Cardinality | Description |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | 1 | `string` | singular | — |
| `team_id` | 2 | `string` | singular | — |
| `sequence` | 3 | `int64` | singular | sequence is server-owned and monotonically increasing within a team. It is<br> the resume cursor used by StreamTeamConversation; delivery-state<br> transitions re-send the same sequence rather than allocating a new one. |
| `author` | 4 | [`deepnavy.v1.ConversationAuthor`](#deepnavy-v1-conversationauthor) | singular | — |
| `text` | 5 | `string` | singular | text is customer-safe prose only: the customer's own words or the Product<br> Manager's reply, never a delivery envelope or runtime output. |
| `created_at` | 6 | `google.protobuf.Timestamp` | singular | — |
| `delivery_state` | 7 | [`deepnavy.v1.ConversationDeliveryState`](#deepnavy-v1-conversationdeliverystate) | singular | delivery_state tracks CUSTOMER-authored rows to the Product Manager<br> session; PRODUCT_MANAGER and SYSTEM rows are always DELIVERED. |
| `safe_error` | 8 | `string` | singular | safe_error is a bounded customer-safe summary set only when<br> delivery_state is FAILED. |

| `text` | 2 | `string` | singular | text is trimmed and must be 1..4000 bytes afterwards. |
| `idempotency_key` | 3 | `string` | singular | idempotency_key is scoped to the authenticated principal. Retrying with<br> the same key returns the already-recorded message. |

 callers never choose their own author.

<a id="deepnavy-v1-conversationdeliverystate"></a>
### Enum `deepnavy.v1.ConversationDeliveryState`

ConversationDeliveryState is the customer-safe delivery state of a
 customer-authored message on its way to the team's persistent Product
 Manager session. PRODUCT_MANAGER and SYSTEM rows are recorded as DELIVERED.
 A retrying delivery remains DELIVERING until it is DELIVERED or FAILED.

| Value | Number | Description |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `CONVERSATION_DELIVERY_STATE_UNSPECIFIED` | 0 | — |
| `CONVERSATION_DELIVERY_STATE_QUEUED` | 1 | — |
| `CONVERSATION_DELIVERY_STATE_DELIVERING` | 2 | — |
| `CONVERSATION_DELIVERY_STATE_DELIVERED` | 3 | — |
| `CONVERSATION_DELIVERY_STATE_FAILED` | 4 | — |

<a id="deepnavy-v1-conversationdispatchfailurereason"></a>
### Enum `deepnavy.v1.ConversationDispatchFailureReason`

ConversationDispatchFailureReason is intentionally bounded and safe to
 expose. It never carries a gateway endpoint, session key, credential, or raw
 runtime error. LEASE_INVALID and IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT are protocol errors
 and are not persisted as customer-visible delivery failures.

| Value | Number | Description |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `CONVERSATION_DISPATCH_FAILURE_REASON_UNSPECIFIED` | 0 | — |
| `CONVERSATION_DISPATCH_FAILURE_REASON_GATEWAY_UNAVAILABLE` | 1 | — |
| `CONVERSATION_DISPATCH_FAILURE_REASON_PM_SESSION_UNAVAILABLE` | 2 | — |
| `CONVERSATION_DISPATCH_FAILURE_REASON_DELIVERY_REJECTED` | 3 | — |
| `CONVERSATION_DISPATCH_FAILURE_REASON_RETRY_EXHAUSTED` | 4 | — |

<a id="deepnavy-v1-teamconversationservice"></a>
### Service `deepnavy.v1.TeamConversationService`

TeamConversationService is the customer-authenticated console conversation
 with a team's Product Manager, authorized like ObjectiveService: tenant
 identity always comes from the verified principal plus a server-checked
 membership, never from request fields.

| RPC | Request | Response | Streaming | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SendTeamMessage` | [`deepnavy.v1.SendTeamMessageRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-sendteammessagerequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.SendTeamMessageResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-sendteammessageresponse) | unary | SendTeamMessage records the customer message and enqueues its durable<br> dispatch to the Product Manager session in one transaction. The server<br> assigns id, sequence, author, and created_at. |
| `StreamTeamConversation` | [`deepnavy.v1.StreamTeamConversationRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-streamteamconversationrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.StreamTeamConversationResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-streamteamconversationresponse) | server | StreamTeamConversation replays messages after the cursor and then follows<br> the conversation, re-sending a message's sequence on every delivery-state<br> transition. |

<a id="deepnavy-v1-teamconversationworkerservice"></a>
### Service `deepnavy.v1.TeamConversationWorkerService`

TeamConversationWorkerService is internal and provisioning-worker
 authenticated, mirroring ObjectiveDispatchWorkerService. It is never mounted
 on the public listener or called from an agent pod.

| RPC | Request | Response | Streaming | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `LeaseConversationDispatches` | [`deepnavy.v1.LeaseConversationDispatchesRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-leaseconversationdispatchesrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.LeaseConversationDispatchesResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-leaseconversationdispatchesresponse) | unary | LeaseConversationDispatches atomically claims queued or retryable<br> dispatches. An expired lease makes the dispatch eligible for redelivery. |
| `RenewConversationDispatchLease` | [`deepnavy.v1.RenewConversationDispatchLeaseRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-renewconversationdispatchleaserequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.RenewConversationDispatchLeaseResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-renewconversationdispatchleaseresponse) | unary | — |
| `AcknowledgeConversationDispatch` | [`deepnavy.v1.AcknowledgeConversationDispatchRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-acknowledgeconversationdispatchrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.AcknowledgeConversationDispatchResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-acknowledgeconversationdispatchresponse) | unary | AcknowledgeConversationDispatch marks the customer message DELIVERED and,<br> when reply_text is present, records the Product Manager reply atomically. |
| `FailConversationDispatch` | [`deepnavy.v1.FailConversationDispatchRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-failconversationdispatchrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.FailConversationDispatchResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-failconversationdispatchresponse) | unary | FailConversationDispatch records a bounded failure. A retryable failure<br> requeues the dispatch until attempts are exhausted; a terminal one marks<br> the customer message FAILED with its customer-safe error. |

EconomicsScope identifies a deep navy accounting scope. id is empty only
 for PLATFORM. For all resource dimensions it is the canonical deep navy
 resource ID; for role, model, provider, and operation it is a stable,
 non-secret platform alias.

<a id="deepnavy-v1-economicssummary"></a>
### Message `deepnavy.v1.EconomicsSummary`

| Field | Number | Type | Cardinality | Description |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| `scope_type` | 1 | `string` | singular | scope_type is a documented deep navy scope name such as "platform",<br> "organization", "team", "agent", "initiative", "issue",<br> "pull_request", or "repository". scope_id is the corresponding deep navy<br> resource ID and is empty only for the platform scope. |
| `scope_id` | 2 | `string` | singular | — |
| `direct_cost` | 3 | [`deepnavy.v1.Money`](#deepnavy-v1-money) | singular | Monetary flows and credits_used_micros cover reporting_period. All Money<br> values use one currency; servers reject mixed-currency aggregation unless<br> they apply and audit an explicit conversion policy. |
| `revenue` | 4 | [`deepnavy.v1.Money`](#deepnavy-v1-money) | singular | — |
| `gross_profit` | 5 | [`deepnavy.v1.Money`](#deepnavy-v1-money) | singular | — |
| `gross_margin` | 6 | `double` | singular | gross_margin is gross_profit / revenue, where 1.0 means 100%. It may be<br> negative. It is zero when revenue is zero; callers that require presence<br> semantics should use the enclosing resource's documented availability. |
| `credits_used_micros` | 7 | `int64` | singular | Engineering Credits use integer microcredits: 1,000,000 equals one credit. |
| `credits_remaining_micros` | 8 | `int64` | singular | credits_remaining_micros is the point-in-time balance at<br> reporting_period.ended_at. |
| `measured_at` | 9 | `google.protobuf.Timestamp` | singular | measured_at is the time through which source ledgers were reconciled. |
| `scope` | 10 | [`deepnavy.v1.EconomicsScope`](#deepnavy-v1-economicsscope) | singular | — |
| `gross_margin_ratio` | 11 | `double` | optional | gross_margin_ratio is gross_profit / revenue, where 1.0 means 100%, and<br> may be negative. Absence means revenue was zero or the source data was not<br> trustworthy enough to calculate the ratio. |
| `reporting_period` | 12 | [`deepnavy.v1.ReportingPeriod`](#deepnavy-v1-reportingperiod) | singular | — |

<a id="deepnavy-v1-completegithubinstallationrequest"></a>
### Message `deepnavy.v1.CompleteGitHubInstallationRequest`

| Field | Number | Type | Cardinality | Description |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| `organization_id` | 1 | `string` | singular | The authenticated principal and organization must match the durable flow<br> created by StartGitHubInstallation. |
| `installation_id` | 2 | `int64` | singular | installation_id and setup_action may be zero/UNSPECIFIED. With OAuth during<br> installation, GitHub guarantees only code and preserved state on the user<br> authorization callback; these setup fields are not guaranteed. Whether<br> supplied or omitted, the server resolves the installation from the durable<br> Start flow baseline and the verified GET /user/installations response. A<br> supplied value may only narrow that trusted result and must match it. The<br> server fails closed if no unique installation can be established. |
| `setup_action` | 3 | [`deepnavy.v1.GitHubInstallationSetupAction`](#deepnavy-v1-githubinstallationsetupaction) | singular | — |
| `state_token` | 4 | `string` | singular | state_token is the opaque, one-time state returned by GitHub. It is a<br> credential: redact it from logs, traces, errors, and analytics. |
| `idempotency_key` | 5 | `string` | singular | idempotency_key is required. A completed flow may be retried with the same<br> normalized request and key, while state-token replay for another request<br> must fail. |
| `authorization_code` | 6 | `string` | singular | authorization_code is the sensitive, one-time OAuth code returned by the<br> product GitHub App when "Request user authorization (OAuth) during<br> installation" is enabled. Exchange it server-side for a GitHub App user<br> access token, verify installation_id appears in GET /user/installations,<br> discard that user token after verification, and then independently confirm<br> the installation with App authentication. Never log, trace, persist, or<br> return this code or exchanged user token to a client. |

| `GIT_HUB_INSTALLATION_ERROR_REASON_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED` | 1 | Returned with INVALID_ARGUMENT. |
| `GIT_HUB_INSTALLATION_ERROR_REASON_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED` | 2 | The key was previously used with a different normalized request. Returned<br> with FAILED_PRECONDITION. |
| `GIT_HUB_INSTALLATION_ERROR_REASON_INVALID_INSTALLATION_STATE` | 3 | The one-time state token is invalid, expired, replayed, or does not belong<br> to the authenticated principal and organization. Returned with<br> FAILED_PRECONDITION without disclosing which condition failed. |
| `GIT_HUB_INSTALLATION_ERROR_REASON_INSTALLATION_NOT_CONFIRMED` | 4 | GitHub did not confirm that the supplied installation exists and belongs<br> to the expected account. Returned with FAILED_PRECONDITION. |
| `GIT_HUB_INSTALLATION_ERROR_REASON_NOT_AUTHORIZED` | 5 | Returned with PERMISSION_DENIED. The server must not reveal whether an<br> inaccessible organization or installation exists globally. |
| `GIT_HUB_INSTALLATION_ERROR_REASON_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE` | 6 | GitHub could not be reached or returned a retryable provider error.<br> Returned with UNAVAILABLE. |

| Value | Number | Description |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `ONBOARDING_ERROR_REASON_UNSPECIFIED` | 0 | — |
| `ONBOARDING_ERROR_REASON_INVALID_ORGANIZATION_NAME` | 1 | Returned with INVALID_ARGUMENT. |

Terminal events also complete the command lease. |

### Message `deepnavy.v1.AgentSession`

AgentSession is an assignment-bound, customer-safe lifecycle projection.
 id is the server-issued opaque session_id from AgentWorkAssignment, never a
 gateway or OpenClaw session key. No prompt, response, reasoning, tool input,
 credential, or raw runtime identifier is retained by this projection.

<a id="deepnavy-v1-createteamrequest"></a>
### Message `deepnavy.v1.CreateTeamRequest`

| Field | Number | Type | Cardinality | Description |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| `organization_id` | 1 | `string` | singular | The authenticated principal must hold an owner or admin membership. The<br> server verifies the active subscription, GitHub installation, and<br> repository selection; browser state is never sufficient authorization. |
| `name` | 2 | `string` | singular | — |
| `idempotency_key` | 3 | `string` | singular | idempotency_key is required. Repeating the same normalized request with<br> the same key returns the original Team and provisioning command. |
| `repository_ids` | 4 | `int64` | repeated | repository_ids are the GitHub repository ids this team works on, chosen<br> from the repositories the organization's active GitHub App installation<br> can reach. The server revalidates every id against the installation —<br> never against browser state — and the validated set becomes this team's<br> own durable selection, snapshotted onto its provisioning command. An id<br> outside the installation's accessible set is rejected with<br> TEAM_ERROR_REASON_REPOSITORY_NOT_ACCESSIBLE. Empty is backward<br> compatible: the organization's durable repository selection is copied to<br> the team, and it must then contain at least one repository. |

| --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- |

<a id="deepnavy-v1-requestteamrequest"></a>
### Message `deepnavy.v1.RequestTeamRequest`

| Field | Number | Type | Cardinality | Description |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| `organization_id` | 1 | `string` | singular | The authenticated principal must hold an owner or admin membership. The<br> server verifies the GitHub installation and durable repository selection;<br> browser state is never sufficient authorization. |
| `name` | 2 | `string` | singular | — |
| `idempotency_key` | 3 | `string` | singular | idempotency_key is required. Repeating the same normalized request with the<br> same key returns the original pending team + settlement without opening a<br> second Checkout Session or charging the saved card twice. |
| `engineer_count` | 4 | `int32` | singular | engineer_count is the number of engineering agents on the team. The minimum<br> is 3 — the adversarial-review floor (an engineer completes a ticket, then<br> two peers can review). The base subscription includes 3 engineers; each<br> engineer above 3 is billed as a recurring add-on. Values below 3 are<br> rejected. A team also always includes one Product Manager, one Engineering<br> Manager, and one Designer, which are not counted here. |
| `objective` | 5 | `string` | singular | objective is the team's imperative — the outcome its agents pursue. The<br> Product Manager turns it into acceptance criteria and Gherkin; the<br> Engineering Manager triages and tags work from it. Optional at request time<br> and refinable later via ObjectiveService. |
| `repository_ids` | 6 | `int64` | repeated | repository_ids are the GitHub repository ids this team works on, with the<br> same semantics and server-side validation as<br> CreateTeamRequest.repository_ids: every id is revalidated against the<br> organization's active GitHub App installation — never against browser<br> state — and the validated set becomes this team's own durable selection.<br> Empty is backward compatible and copies the organization's durable<br> repository selection. |

<a id="deepnavy-v1-requestteamresponse"></a>
### Message `deepnavy.v1.RequestTeamResponse`

| Field | Number | Type | Cardinality | Description |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| `pending_team` | 1 | [`deepnavy.v1.Team`](#deepnavy-v1-team) | singular | pending_team is the team in LIFECYCLE_STATE_PENDING. It becomes active only<br> after the signed Stripe webhook confirms payment and provisioning succeeds. |
| `settlement` | 2 | [`deepnavy.v1.RequestTeamSettlement`](#deepnavy-v1-requestteamsettlement) | singular | — |
| `checkout_client_secret` | 3 | `string` | singular | Set only when settlement == CHECKOUT_REQUIRED. Feed to Stripe Embedded<br> Checkout (initEmbeddedCheckout). A short-lived credential — never log it. |
| `authentication_url` | 4 | `string` | singular | Set only when settlement == AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED. A short-lived hosted<br> Stripe invoice URL for 3-D Secure. A credential — never log it. |

<a id="deepnavy-v1-setteamengineercountrequest"></a>
### Message `deepnavy.v1.SetTeamEngineerCountRequest`

| Field | Number | Type | Cardinality | Description |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| `team_id` | 1 | `string` | singular | The team whose engineering-agent count changes. The authenticated principal<br> must hold an owner or admin membership on the team's organization. |
| `engineer_count` | 2 | `int32` | singular | engineer_count is the new number of engineering agents (minimum 3 — the<br> adversarial-review floor; bounded above by the server). Increasing it charges<br> the saved card off-session for the prorated remainder of the current period;<br> decreasing it credits the unused portion to the next invoice. Values below the<br> floor or above the maximum are rejected with INVALID_ARGUMENT. |
| `idempotency_key` | 3 | `string` | singular | idempotency_key is required. Repeating the same normalized request with the<br> same key returns the same outcome without charging the saved card twice. |

<a id="deepnavy-v1-setteamengineercountresponse"></a>
### Message `deepnavy.v1.SetTeamEngineerCountResponse`

| Field | Number | Type | Cardinality | Description |
| --- | ---: | --- | --- | --- |
| `team` | 1 | [`deepnavy.v1.Team`](#deepnavy-v1-team) | singular | team carries the updated engineer_count once the change is applied. |
| `settlement` | 2 | [`deepnavy.v1.RequestTeamSettlement`](#deepnavy-v1-requestteamsettlement) | singular | settlement reports how the change settled. CHARGED_OFF_SESSION: applied — an<br> increase was charged, or a decrease was credited to the next invoice.<br> AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED: the off-session increase needs 3-D Secure; open<br> authentication_url. CHECKOUT_REQUIRED is never returned (the team already has a<br> subscription). A hard decline returns FAILED_PRECONDITION (PAYMENT_DECLINED),<br> not a response, and leaves the engineer_count unchanged. |
| `authentication_url` | 3 | `string` | singular | Set only when settlement == AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED. A short-lived hosted<br> Stripe invoice URL for 3-D Secure. A credential — never log it. |

<a id="deepnavy-v1-teamerrorreason"></a>
### Enum `deepnavy.v1.TeamErrorReason`

| Value | Number | Description |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `TEAM_ERROR_REASON_UNSPECIFIED` | 0 | — |
| `TEAM_ERROR_REASON_NOT_ACCESSIBLE` | 1 | Returned with NOT_FOUND for an unknown or inaccessible team or<br> organization. The server must not distinguish those cases. |
| `TEAM_ERROR_REASON_GITHUB_INSTALLATION_REQUIRED` | 2 | Returned with FAILED_PRECONDITION when there is no active GitHub App<br> installation for the organization. |
| `TEAM_ERROR_REASON_REPOSITORY_SELECTION_REQUIRED` | 3 | Returned with FAILED_PRECONDITION when no repository selection is ready. |
| `TEAM_ERROR_REASON_ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED` | 4 | Returned with FAILED_PRECONDITION unless the server-verified subscription<br> is active and has a verified paid billing period. |
| `TEAM_ERROR_REASON_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED` | 5 | Returned with INVALID_ARGUMENT. |
| `TEAM_ERROR_REASON_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED` | 6 | The key was previously used with a different normalized request. Returned<br> with FAILED_PRECONDITION. |
| `TEAM_ERROR_REASON_NOT_AUTHORIZED` | 7 | Returned with PERMISSION_DENIED when the authenticated member lacks the<br> owner or admin role required for a team mutation. |
| `TEAM_ERROR_REASON_PAID_TEAM_SLOTS_EXHAUSTED` | 8 | Returned with RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED when non-deleted teams already consume<br> every paid Stripe licensed-quantity slot. |
| `TEAM_ERROR_REASON_PAYMENT_DECLINED` | 9 | Returned with FAILED_PRECONDITION when the off-session charge for an<br> additional team was declined by the saved card. No pending team is created. |
| `TEAM_ERROR_REASON_PAYMENT_METHOD_REQUIRED` | 10 | Returned with FAILED_PRECONDITION when the organization has no saved<br> payment method on file for an off-session charge (should not occur after<br> the first team's checkout). |
| `TEAM_ERROR_REASON_REPOSITORY_NOT_ACCESSIBLE` | 11 | At least one requested repository id is not currently accessible through<br> the organization's active GitHub App installation. Returned with<br> FAILED_PRECONDITION without revealing whether a repository belonging to<br> another tenant exists. |

<a id="deepnavy-v1-requestteamsettlement"></a>
### Enum `deepnavy.v1.RequestTeamSettlement`

RequestTeamSettlement describes how a RequestTeam call is paid for.

| Value | Number | Description |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `REQUEST_TEAM_SETTLEMENT_UNSPECIFIED` | 0 | — |
| `REQUEST_TEAM_SETTLEMENT_CHECKOUT_REQUIRED` | 1 | First team on the organization (no subscription yet). Mount Stripe Embedded<br> Checkout with checkout_client_secret to collect + save the card and start<br> the $599/month subscription. The team provisions after the signed webhook<br> confirms payment. |
| `REQUEST_TEAM_SETTLEMENT_CHARGED_OFF_SESSION` | 2 | A subscription with a saved card already exists: its quantity was<br> incremented and the prorated amount charged off-session. Poll GetTeam until<br> the pending team goes active. |
| `REQUEST_TEAM_SETTLEMENT_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED` | 3 | The off-session charge requires 3-D Secure. Open authentication_url (a<br> hosted Stripe invoice) to authenticate; the team provisions once paid. |

<a id="deepnavy-v1-teamservice"></a>
### Service `deepnavy.v1.TeamService`

| RPC | Request | Response | Streaming | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GetTeam` | [`deepnavy.v1.GetTeamRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-getteamrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.GetTeamResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-getteamresponse) | unary | — |
| `ListTeams` | [`deepnavy.v1.ListTeamsRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-listteamsrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.ListTeamsResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-listteamsresponse) | unary | — |
| `CreateTeam` | [`deepnavy.v1.CreateTeamRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-createteamrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.CreateTeamResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-createteamresponse) | unary | CreateTeam requires an owner or admin membership and is idempotent by the<br> authenticated principal and idempotency_key. It is the internal/legacy path<br> that requires a pre-existing paid slot; customer flows use RequestTeam. |
| `RequestTeam` | [`deepnavy.v1.RequestTeamRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-requestteamrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.RequestTeamResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-requestteamresponse) | unary | RequestTeam is the customer entry point for creating a team and is the<br> moment payment is collected. It captures the team, then either starts the<br> subscription (first team, via embedded Checkout) or charges the saved card<br> off-session (subsequent teams, incrementing the licensed quantity). The<br> team row is provisioned by the signed Stripe webhook, never inline. It is<br> idempotent by the authenticated principal and idempotency_key. |
| `SuspendTeam` | [`deepnavy.v1.SuspendTeamRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-suspendteamrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.SuspendTeamResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-suspendteamresponse) | unary | — |
| `ResumeTeam` | [`deepnavy.v1.ResumeTeamRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-resumeteamrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.ResumeTeamResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-resumeteamresponse) | unary | — |
| `DeleteTeam` | [`deepnavy.v1.DeleteTeamRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-deleteteamrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.DeleteTeamResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-deleteteamresponse) | unary | — |
| `SetTeamEngineerCount` | [`deepnavy.v1.SetTeamEngineerCountRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-setteamengineercountrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.SetTeamEngineerCountResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-setteamengineercountresponse) | unary | SetTeamEngineerCount changes the number of engineering agents on an existing<br> team and settles the difference on the org's subscription: an increase charges<br> the saved card off-session (prorated), a decrease credits the next invoice. The<br> team must already have an active subscription. Idempotent by principal + key. |

AgentWorkAssignment is the only authoritative per-request work context. It
 is server-issued, versioned, expiring, and immutable. Economics atomically
 claims the current row while reserving credits; model callers cannot supply
 or override any work identity in this message.

<a id="deepnavy-v1-objectivedispatchworkerservice"></a>
### Service `deepnavy.v1.ObjectiveDispatchWorkerService`

ObjectiveDispatchWorkerService is internal and provisioning-worker
 authenticated. It is never mounted on the public listener or called from an
 agent pod. A lease transaction installs the TPM assignment before returning
 a dispatch, so a model request cannot race ahead of its authoritative scope.

| RPC | Request | Response | Streaming | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `LeaseObjectiveDispatches` | [`deepnavy.v1.LeaseObjectiveDispatchesRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-leaseobjectivedispatchesrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.LeaseObjectiveDispatchesResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-leaseobjectivedispatchesresponse) | unary | — |
| `RenewObjectiveDispatchLease` | [`deepnavy.v1.RenewObjectiveDispatchLeaseRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-renewobjectivedispatchleaserequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.RenewObjectiveDispatchLeaseResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-renewobjectivedispatchleaseresponse) | unary | — |
| `AcknowledgeObjectiveDispatch` | [`deepnavy.v1.AcknowledgeObjectiveDispatchRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-acknowledgeobjectivedispatchrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.AcknowledgeObjectiveDispatchResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-acknowledgeobjectivedispatchresponse) | unary | — |
| `FailObjectiveDispatch` | [`deepnavy.v1.FailObjectiveDispatchRequest`](#deepnavy-v1-failobjectivedispatchrequest) | [`deepnavy.v1.FailObjectiveDispatchResponse`](#deepnavy-v1-failobjectivedispatchresponse) | unary | — |

<a id="deepnavy-v1-agentworkworkerservice"></a>
### Service `deepnavy.v1.AgentWorkWorkerService`

AgentWorkWorkerService is internal and agent-stream authenticated. The
 service revalidates tenant, generation, caller role, and every referenced
 resource in the same transaction; a caller cannot assign arbitrary IDs.

| RPC | Request | Response | Streaming | Description |

<a id="deepnavy-v1-workspacechange"></a>
### Message `deepnavy.v1.WorkspaceChange`

WorkspaceChange is an assignment-bound projection for one selected customer
 repository. relative_path is canonical and repository-relative. safe_diff is
 text-only, line-bounded, at most 4 KiB, and passes credential, connection
 string, private-key, token, and high-entropy redaction before persistence.
 On any uncertainty the service omits it and returns a typed unavailability.
